name: Horn Skuld
source:
Age: Unknown

Horn is a seventeenth progenitor and one of [url=/c40806]Crowley's[/url] vampire servants. She is a proper lady and is fond of both him and [url=/c40807]Chess[/url], always shown to be together with the two. She takes her duties seriously and scolds Chess for her misbehavior, acting something like an elder sister. Chess considers her to be stuffy.

Remaining level-headed and keeping a cool composure allows her to observe her opponents and wait for a good opportunity to strike. 

[From [url=http://owarinoseraph.wikia.com/wiki/Horn_Skuld]Owari no Seraph Wiki[/url]]
